resolution_rule.yes: Gross headline commitments must be strictly greater than $60,000,000 at any point before 2026-11-02 23:59 ET; exactly $60m is NO.
resolution_rule.measure: Frozen official host 1wtoken.com page US$X of US$allocation; include oversubscription, not final net allocation after refunds. Prior excess-refund/cancellation does not undo an already qualifying displayed amount. No verifiable commitment total by deadline or sale held/cancelled/rescheduled beyond deadline => NO.

static_source_findings.api_base: Captured client bundle sets entrypoint `/api`; URL builder concatenates entrypoint and route. Static sale module declares `/v1/token-api/token/sale/state`; resolved source-defined URL requested: https://1wtoken.com/api/v1/token-api/token/sale/state.
static_source_findings.method_body: Static module specifies POST, optional auth; with no partner ID it provides no request body. Request sent unauthenticated with no body; no wallet/local-storage/signing integration.
static_source_findings.endpoint_shape: Static hook reads state.saleStartDate, state.saleEndDate, state.phase and stats.totalMoneySpent, stats.totalUserAmount, stats.multiplicator. UI renders totalMoneySpent as `current` in total_quantity, formats it as money against sale goal, and displays oversubscription multiplier. Static response cannot establish current dates/total because API request returned 403.
static_source_findings.gross_net: Sale page uses totalMoneySpent for displayed current amount. Public static contract IDL describes deposits_usdc_contributed as USDC collected, increasing on purchase and decreasing on refunds until pool fixed; pool_fixed_amount snapshots the counter at pool fixation. No captured mapping proves API totalMoneySpent equals this field or the market’s gross headline. A decreasing pre-fix counter is not demonstrably a cumulative all-time gross high; UI arithmetic alone does not settle frozen-rule equivalence.
